# Load Libraries and Data

```{r libraries}
libraries <- c(
  "haven", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "reshape2",
  "viridis", "knitr", "kableExtra", "naniar", "VIM", "mice"
)

for (pkg in libraries) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

invisible(lapply(libraries, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r load_data}
# Load data
dat <- read_sas("data/alzheimer25.sas7bdat")

# Reshape to long format
reshape_dat <- function(dat) {
    dat_long <- dat %>%
        pivot_longer(
            cols = matches("^(bprs|cdrsb|abpet|taupet)\\d+"),
            names_to = c(".value", "time"),
            names_pattern = "(.+)(\\d+)"
        )
    dat_long
}

to_factor <- function(dat_long) {
    dat_long <- dat_long %>%
        mutate(
            time = as.factor(time),
            sex = as.factor(sex),
            edu = as.factor(edu),
            trial = as.factor(trial),
            job = as.factor(job),
            wzc = as.factor(wzc),
            time_num = as.numeric(time)
        )
    dat_long
}

dat_long <- reshape_dat(dat)
dat_long <- to_factor(dat_long)

# Create wide format with key variables for pattern analysis
dat_wide_key <- dat %>%
  select(patid, age, sex, wzc, bmi, adl, trial,
         bprs0, bprs1, bprs2, bprs3, bprs4, bprs5, bprs6,
         cdrsb0, cdrsb1, cdrsb2, cdrsb3, cdrsb4, cdrsb5, cdrsb6)
```

# 1. Basic Missingness Statistics

```{r basic_stats}
# Count missing values per variable
missing_summary <- dat %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "N_Missing") %>%
  mutate(
    N_Total = nrow(dat),
    Prop_Missing = N_Missing / N_Total
  ) %>%
  filter(N_Missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Missing))

kable(missing_summary, digits = 3, 
      caption = "Variables with Missing Values") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r missingness_by_time}
# Missingness by time point for key outcome variables
miss_by_time <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(time_num) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Total = n(),
    BPRS_Missing = sum(is.na(bprs)),
    BPRS_Prop = BPRS_Missing / N_Total,
    CDRSB_Missing = sum(is.na(cdrsb)),
    CDRSB_Prop = CDRSB_Missing / N_Total,
    ABPET_Missing = sum(is.na(abpet)),
    ABPET_Prop = ABPET_Missing / N_Total,
    TAUPET_Missing = sum(is.na(taupet)),
    TAUPET_Prop = TAUPET_Missing / N_Total
  )

kable(miss_by_time, digits = 3,
      caption = "Missingness by Time Point") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r missing_proportion_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
miss_by_time_long <- miss_by_time %>%
  select(time_num, BPRS_Prop, CDRSB_Prop, ABPET_Prop, TAUPET_Prop) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -time_num,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Variable = gsub("_Prop", "", Variable))

ggplot(miss_by_time_long, aes(x = time_num, y = Proportion, color = Variable, group = Variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Missing Observations Over Time",
    x = "Time Point",
    y = "Proportion Missing",
    color = "Outcome Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## 2.3 Monotone vs Non-Monotone Missingness

```{r monotone_pattern}
# Check if dropout is monotone (once you drop out, you stay out)
dat_dropout_pattern <- dat %>%
  select(patid, starts_with("bprs")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("bprs"), ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, 1)))

# For each patient, check if pattern is monotone
check_monotone <- function(row) {
  vals <- as.numeric(row[-1])  # Exclude patid
  # Monotone means: 1,1,1,...,1,0,0,0 (no return after dropout)
  if (all(!is.na(vals))) {
    # Find first 0
    first_zero <- which(vals == 0)[1]
    if (is.na(first_zero)) return(TRUE)  # No missingness
    # Check if all subsequent values are 0
    return(all(vals[first_zero:length(vals)] == 0))
  }
  return(FALSE)
}

monotone_results <- dat_dropout_pattern %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(is_monotone = check_monotone(c_across(everything()))) %>%
  ungroup()

monotone_summary <- monotone_results %>%
  summarise(
    N_Total = n(),
    N_Monotone = sum(is_monotone),
    N_NonMonotone = sum(!is_monotone),
    Prop_Monotone = N_Monotone / N_Total
  )

kable(monotone_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = "Monotone vs Non-Monotone Dropout Pattern") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


## 3.1 Dropout by Age

```{r dropout_by_age, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Create missingness indicators
dat$dropout_year1 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs1))
dat$dropout_year2 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs2))
dat$dropout_year3 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs3))
dat$dropout_year4 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs4))
dat$dropout_year5 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs5))
dat$dropout_year6 <- as.numeric(is.na(dat$bprs6))

# Calculate time to dropout
dat$time_to_dropout <- apply(dat[, paste0("dropout_year", 1:6)], 1, function(x) {
  first_na <- which(x == 1)[1]
  if (is.na(first_na)) return(7)  # Never dropped out
  return(first_na)
})

# Age vs time to dropout
ggplot(dat, aes(x = factor(time_to_dropout), y = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution by Time to Dropout",
    x = "Year of Dropout (7 = No Dropout)",
    y = "Age at Baseline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r age_density_dropout, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Compare age distribution between completers and dropouts
dat_age_dropout <- dat %>%
  mutate(completer = ifelse(is.na(bprs6), "Dropout", "Completer"))

ggplot(dat_age_dropout, aes(x = age, fill = completer)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dropout" = "#d73027", "Completer" = "#4575b4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution: Completers vs Dropouts at Year 6",
    x = "Age at Baseline",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Statistical test
t.test(age ~ completer, data = dat_age_dropout)
```

## 3.3 Dropout by Sex

```{r dropout_by_sex, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
dropout_sex_summary <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    dropout_status = ifelse(is.na(bprs6), "Dropout", "Completer")
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex, dropout_status) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  mutate(Prop = N / sum(N))

ggplot(dropout_sex_summary, aes(x = sex, y = Prop, fill = dropout_status)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Prop * 100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dropout" = "#d73027", "Completer" = "#4575b4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Dropout Rate by Sex",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Chi-square test
chisq.test(table(dat %>% 
                   mutate(sex = factor(sex, labels = c("Male", "Female"))) %>%
                   pull(sex), 
                 dat_age_dropout$completer))
```

## 3.4 Correlation Between Baseline Variables and Missingness

```{r correlation_missingness, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Create correlation matrix between baseline variables and dropout indicators
corr_data <- dat %>%
  select(age, bprs0, cdrsb0, bmi, adl, 
         dropout_year1, dropout_year2, dropout_year3, 
         dropout_year4, dropout_year5, dropout_year6)

cor_matrix <- cor(corr_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Extract correlations with dropout indicators
cor_with_dropout <- cor_matrix[1:5, 6:11]

melted_cor <- melt(cor_with_dropout)
colnames(melted_cor) <- c("Baseline_Variable", "Dropout_Year", "Correlation")

ggplot(melted_cor, aes(x = Dropout_Year, y = Baseline_Variable, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), color = "white", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027", 
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Between Baseline Variables and Dropout",
    x = "Dropout Indicator",
    y = "Baseline Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
